mission: Make research-assistant let another agent or user start from an idea, topic, or paper, ask once for exploratory public discovery, then use local cache, public web/API metadata, public archives, source/status lookup, and bounded source/PDF/full-text retrieval to build an auditable survey evidence packet.

authoritative_status.completed_scope: M16 Phases 0-10, M17 topic/bootstrap engineering, and M18 identified local Git/install reproducibility in the observed environment

historical_records_policy: M0-M15 retain their original objectives, checks, handoffs, and stop conditions as planning history only. They are not current execution authority. Current work is governed exclusively by authoritative_status, active_milestones, north_star_sequence, the M16 close record, and the north-star gap-closure master program.

approval_layers.development_validation_authority: Fresh repository-execution approvals may be required for Codex to run a predeclared network/source validation while developing and evaluating M19-M21. They authorize only that frozen supervised run.
approval_layers.production_end_user_confirmation: At product runtime, one persisted bounded public-discovery confirmation covers all implemented in-scope ordinary public metadata, citation, archive, source-status, and capped public source/PDF/full-text actions. The workflow must not prompt again merely because it advances from metadata to citation or source transport.
approval_layers.always_separate_boundaries: Credentials, private or paid sources, hidden data, unbounded crawling, writes outside the mission, genuine human review decisions, product defaults, and release remain separate explicit decisions.

status_legend.completed_superseded_by_m16: The historical milestone was implemented and its authority is now subsumed by the stronger M16 local integrated-alpha evidence.
status_legend.completed_local_scope_superseded_by_m16: The local or fixture-backed part was implemented and superseded by M16; no live claim is implied.
status_legend.superseded_incomplete_live_scope: Local or sanitized predecessors exist, but the milestone's live scope was not established and is replaced by M19-M21.
status_legend.passed_local_engineering_git_integration: M16 Phases 0-10 passed on the preserved dirty-tree baseline; Git reproducibility and live behavior remain outside the claim.
status_legend.active_planning_local_only: The milestone is the current local planning lane; it authorizes neither live action nor Git mutation.
status_legend.active_planning_no_git_action_authorized: Historical setup state: the milestone was a Git planning lane with no mutation authority.
status_legend.active_local_integration: The milestone is the active trusted-local integration lane under the user's execute/resume request and current repository policy; push, release, destructive actions, and later external boundaries remain unauthorized.
status_legend.completed_local_git_install_reproducibil: An identified commit passed the declared isolated clone, offline wheel, origin, payload, and local regression gates in the observed environment; no live or product-readiness claim follows.
status_legend.completed_local_engineering_git_integrat: The milestone's local engineering and review gates passed; clean Git integration and later live/product evidence remain outside the claim.
status_legend.pending: The milestone has not met its entry conditions or promotion criterion.

north_star_completion_definition: A clean checkout of an identified commit installs and exposes the documented ra command.
A user can start from a topic, title, DOI, or arXiv identifier and record one bounded public-discovery confirmation for the mission.

The workflow performs allowed local, metadata, citation, source-status, and capped public source/PDF/full-text steps through reviewed production transports, or records an exact honest boundary outcome.
Every technical claim admitted to the reviewed packet has checked primary-source anchors or an explicit project derivation and a genuine human-attested decision.
Source-safety, omission, workflow-blocker, hostile-review, and lineage gates remain fail-closed under resume, provider failure, stale artifacts, and partial evidence.
At least one predeclared real mission reaches terminal_ready_for_reviewed_prose_within_recorded_scope and the representative mission matrix records honest outcomes for all other runs.

A new independent operator uses documentation only and a clean install to take an idea/topic start through production bootstrap to terminal_ready_for_reviewed_prose_within_recorded_scope; separate acceptance cases demonstrate honest boundary stops.
Completion does not claim literature completeness, scientific correctness, broad provider reliability, autonomous human review, or production readiness beyond the recorded scope.
global_boundaries: No actual Codex, Claude, Copilot, or paid model-subject trial is part of this lane.
Benchmark work is support infrastructure, not the mission.
Ordinary exploratory public/local discovery should require one user confirmation per mission, not separate provider-shaped approvals.

The single public-discovery confirmation may cover bounded public web/API metadata, public archive search, local cache lookup, public source-status checks, and capped public source/PDF/full-text retrieval inside the mission output directory.

The single public-discovery confirmation does not authorize credentials, private databases, paid model-worker trials, hidden evaluator material, unbounded crawling, or writes outside the mission output directory.
Technical claims require checked primary-source anchors or explicit source-gap labels.
Citation counts, venue metadata, abstracts, source availability, and unreviewed downloaded text are routing signals only, not technical claim support.
Skeleton, replay, metadata, or source-availability evidence must not be described as product readiness, survey completeness, or scientific correctness.
review_queue.json is a handoff artifact only; queue creation does not review claims, clear source safety, resolve omissions, or make prose ready.
Reviewed-claim import must require checked source anchors and explicit review provenance; unreviewed claim candidates remain non-support.
Reviewed-claim import is a sidecar handoff; it does not clear source safety, omission review, or final prose readiness.
Source-safety rows may be marked checked_clear only by explicit reviewed evidence or public safety lookup performed under the mission public-discovery confirmation.
Reviewed source-safety import is a sidecar handoff; it does not resolve omissions, merge claims, or make prose ready.
Omission-risk rows may be closed only by explicit reviewed rationale or recorded blockers.
Reviewed omission import is a sidecar handoff; it does not prove literature completeness, merge claims, or make prose ready.
Reviewed evidence merge may mark prose ready only when claim, source-safety, omission, and stale-artifact gates all pass.
Reviewed evidence merge status is a readiness/blocker artifact; it does not imply product readiness or scientific correctness.

Resume orchestration should ask exactly once for public discovery when the mission lacks confirmation, then continue automatically through bounded public/local discovery steps once confirmation is recorded.
Coverage and snowballing ledgers are routing/blocker artifacts only; they do not prove literature completeness or technical support.
Hostile review may mark final prose ready only when reviewed evidence, coverage, snowballing, omission, and source-safety gates all pass.

milestones.objective: Allow the north-star command to start honestly from an idea or topic without requiring the user to invent a paper seed, while preserving deterministic mission identity, confirmation, lineage, and exact bootstrap-candidate authority.
entry_conditions: M16 is passed and its frozen hashes match before any M17 product edit.
The current mismatch is recorded: CLI --seed is required and mission_state rejects an empty seed set although the mission promises idea/topic starts.
No live provider or Git action is needed for the initial implementation and fixture validation.
required_artifacts: A reviewed M17 subplan defining topic-only mission identity, bootstrap states, candidate selection, resume, and migration semantics.
An immutable pre-edit M16 historical snapshot that copies every hash-bound file M17 will change and replays the M16 manifest at the entry cutoff.
CLI and mission-state support for an explicitly empty initial paper-seed set or another equally honest idea/topic input representation.
Fixture-backed topic-only and idea-text bootstrap authority with exact selected candidates and nonclaims.
Focused positive, ambiguity, empty-result, confirmation, resume, stale, and adversarial tests.
A cumulative M17 successor manifest binding the current M16+M17 product, schemas, tests, fixtures, documentation, and inherited historical snapshot.
required_checks: Topic-only invocation creates a stable mission before public confirmation without inventing a paper identity.
After confirmation, bootstrap discovery yields a lineage-bound selected seed candidate set or an exact empty/ambiguous boundary stop.
Resume preserves the original input mode and rejects changed topic, idea, or selected bootstrap authority.
Existing explicit identifier/title seed behavior and all M16 evidence boundaries remain unchanged.
The pre-edit historical snapshot still matches the old M16 hashes, while the current candidate matches the separate M17 successor manifest.

evidence_contract.question: Can a user genuinely start the one-command workflow from an idea or topic without a fabricated seed and without weakening mission identity?
evidence_contract.baseline: M16 requires one or more explicit paper seeds at both CLI and mission-state layers.
evidence_contract.primary_criterion: Fixture-backed idea/topic missions reach exact bootstrap selection or honest no-candidate/ambiguity terminals, persist stable lineage, and preserve all explicit-seed behavior.
veto_diagnostics: The topic text is silently treated as a paper title or identifier.
A mission changes identity when bootstrap candidates arrive.
Discovery occurs before confirmation.
Empty or ambiguous bootstrap results disappear or become false readiness.
Existing explicit-seed resume or lineage behavior regresses.

handoff_conditions: M18 receives passing explicit-seed and idea/topic local matrices, the immutable M16 historical snapshot, and the cumulative M17 successor manifest.
Live bootstrap quality remains for M19-M20 and is not inferred from fixtures.
stop_conditions: A stable topic-only mission identity cannot be represented without breaking supported explicit-seed resume.
Bootstrap selection cannot distinguish empty, ambiguous, and selected outcomes exactly.
Implementation would require live execution or Git mutation before the reviewed local contract passes.

milestones.name: Reproducible Git Integration
milestones.objective: Define and execute a bounded integration of the cumulative M16+M17 product, schemas, tests, fixtures, documentation, historical evidence, and governing artifacts so an isolated clean checkout reproduces both idea/topic and explicit-paper workflow modes.
entry_conditions: M17 idea/topic bootstrap and the inherited M16 explicit-seed matrix pass under the cumulative M17 successor manifest.
The immutable M16 historical snapshot replays the old M16 manifest; current working paths are governed by the M17 successor manifest and need not retain pre-M17 hashes.
A path-complete integration manifest distinguishes product, tests, fixtures, canonical evidence, diagnostic-only roots, and unrelated user work.
The user separately authorizes the exact staging and commit procedure before any Git mutation.
required_artifacts: A reviewed path-complete Git integration subplan.
An exact cumulative include/exclude manifest covering all M16 and M17 runtime, schema, test, fixture, documentation, and evidence dependencies, not only Phase 10 files.
An isolated clean-checkout or worktree validation report tied to an identified commit.
Install/import/CLI/full-local-gate logs from the isolated checkout.
required_checks: The immutable historical snapshot matches the old M16 manifest and the current tree matches the M17 successor manifest before integration.
Every M17 runtime, schema, test, fixture, and documentation path is included or explicitly justified as non-runtime historical evidence.
No diagnostic-only or unrelated dirty path is included.
A clean checkout installs without depending on untracked files.
The clean checkout passes topic/idea bootstrap and explicit-seed E2E plus full unit, CLI, script, static, and diff gates.

evidence_contract.question: Can the completed local alpha be reproduced from Git without depending on the current dirty workspace?
evidence_contract.baseline: M16 passed on a heavily dirty, partly untracked worktree and M17 creates a cumulative successor after preserving the historical M16 bytes it changes.
evidence_contract.primary_criterion: An identified clean checkout contains every cumulative M16+M17 dependency and passes both input modes plus the predeclared local gate matrix.
veto_diagnostics: An untracked dependency is required.
Unrelated user work or diagnostic-only evidence is staged.
The clean checkout changes the frozen M16 semantics.
Any destructive Git operation is required.

handoff_conditions: M19 receives an immutable clean-checkout commit and passing local manifest.
No live approval is implied by Git integration.
stop_conditions: The exact integration set cannot be separated from unrelated user work.
Clean-checkout validation fails for a missing or divergent dependency.
The required Git mutation has not been explicitly authorized.

milestones.name: Bounded Live Metadata Validation
milestones.objective: Converge the transport-hardening plan and run one explicitly approved, one-shot, metadata-only OpenAlex/arXiv integration smoke with closed HTTP, time, byte, retry, redirect, proxy, IPC, artifact, and write boundaries.
entry_conditions: M18 clean-checkout authority exists.
The dedicated transport/supervisor hardening subplan, code, tests, hashes, and parent Phase 11 plan receive independent AGREE verdicts.
The user gives fresh exact-scope approval after all hashes and endpoints are frozen.
required_artifacts: Reviewed Phase 11 hardening subplan and result.
Final reviewed Phase 11 parent plan and exact approval artifact.
One-shot request ledger, run manifest, boundary classification, provider outcome, and result review.
required_checks: No network occurs during preflight or local hardening tests.
The one approved launch stays inside exact endpoint, query, request, byte, time, process, and write caps.
Boundary validity is classified separately from provider availability and result counts.
There is no automatic rerun after any outcome.

evidence_contract.question: Does the reviewed metadata transport stay inside its exact boundary, and what integration outcome occurs for this one attempt?
evidence_contract.baseline: M16 fixture-backed V2 metadata behavior from a reproducible checkout.
evidence_contract.primary_criterion: The boundary is valid and the attempt produces a replay-valid available or honest unavailable provider outcome.
veto_diagnostics: Unapproved endpoint, method, query, proxy, redirect, retry, request, byte, time, process, or write behavior.
Missing or ambiguous approval.
Provider output cannot be represented by the closed schema.

handoff_conditions: M20 receives a reviewed transport primitive and one bounded live metadata result.
Source, PDF/full-text, and broader citation routes remain unauthorized.
stop_conditions: Any preflight invariant or exact hash fails.
The plan does not converge after the declared review cap.
Fresh exact live approval is absent.

milestones.name: Live Discovery And Citation Frontier
milestones.objective: Replace fixture-only discovery/frontier capabilities with reviewed production adapters for idea/topic bootstrap, title/identifier resolution, backward references, forward citations, adjacent clusters, and dated omission-risk outcomes under one mission confirmation.
entry_conditions: M19 boundary-valid metadata transport exists.
Exact provider routes, caps, caching, provenance, retry policy, and failure classifications are reviewed before implementation or live use.
required_artifacts: Production discovery/frontier adapter contract and implementation.
No-network contract tests and recorded-response replay fixtures.
A production idea/topic bootstrap route that selects exact paper seed candidates or records empty/ambiguous/unavailable outcomes without changing mission identity.
Bounded live frontier manifests with query dates and provider provenance.
Provider disagreement, empty frontier, partial outage, ambiguity, and cap-exhaustion evidence.
required_checks: All live calls require the persisted mission confirmation and remain mission-scoped.
At least one bounded real idea/topic bootstrap attempt produces lineage-valid selected candidates or an exact honest bootstrap stop.
Every frontier attempt is represented exactly once as included, excluded, unavailable, capped, ambiguous, or failed.
Metadata and citation signals remain routing evidence only.
Resume is idempotent and stale provider results invalidate dependent authority.

evidence_contract.question: Can real bounded idea/topic or paper discovery populate honest, replayable bootstrap and citation-frontier authority without inventing coverage or identity truth?
evidence_contract.baseline: M16 deterministic metadata and recorded-relation frontier fixtures.
evidence_contract.primary_criterion: Predeclared live paper-seed and idea/topic missions produce complete attempt ledgers and lineage-valid bootstrap/frontier authority or exact boundary stops.
veto_diagnostics: A provider call occurs without confirmation.
A failed or capped frontier disappears.
Cross-provider ambiguity is silently merged.
Citation counts or retrieved volume become completeness evidence.

handoff_conditions: M21 receives selected real candidates and exact attempt/omission ledgers.
Unresolved frontiers remain visible review or expansion blockers.
stop_conditions: A provider's terms, endpoint behavior, or schema cannot fit the reviewed bounded contract.
Required live authority is absent.
Real results expose an unrepresentable identity or omission state.

milestones.name: Live Source Status And Anchor Intake
milestones.objective: Implement reviewed production source-status and capped public source/PDF/full-text transports that create mission-local records and checked primary technical anchors while preserving quarantine and source-gap semantics.
entry_conditions: M20 selected candidates and lineage-valid discovery authority exist.
A separate reviewed and approved source-access plan names domains, artifact types, licenses, caps, parsers, write root, retention, and privacy handling.
required_artifacts: Production MissionSourceCapability adapters and closed outcome schemas.
Mission-local source/status records with content hashes, versions, provenance, and license/access outcomes.
Anchor inventories for sections, equations, theorems, and derivations where genuinely available.
Quarantine, unavailable, parser-failure, and source-gap records.
required_checks: No source action occurs outside approved domains, types, caps, or mission root.
Unavailable or unparsed material cannot become inspected evidence.
Technical anchors replay to exact source bytes and versions.
Parser output is not promoted to correctness without human checking.

evidence_contract.question: Can selected real papers yield exact source-status and checked-anchor candidates through bounded mission-local transports?
evidence_contract.baseline: M16 injectable fixture source capability and local anchor contracts.
evidence_contract.primary_criterion: Each selected source has an exact honest outcome and every admitted anchor binds to inspected bytes and location.
veto_diagnostics: Outside-root write or unapproved retrieval.
Wrong version or stale source accepted.
Unavailable or parser-only content represented as checked support.
Quarantine or retraction signal ignored.

handoff_conditions: M22 receives real, hash-bound source observations and anchor candidates plus all source gaps.
No review decision is synthesized by transport code.
stop_conditions: Source rights, privacy, or access boundary is unclear.
The exact source version cannot be established.
The parser cannot preserve auditable source locations.

milestones.name: Human-Attested Review And Real Missions
milestones.objective: Provide an explicit operator workflow for genuine human claim, source-safety, omission, and workflow-blocker decisions, then execute a predeclared representative real-mission matrix through merge, reviewed packet, hostile review, and terminal state.
entry_conditions: M21 real source observations and anchors exist.
The human-review identity, attestation, conflict-of-interest, correction, and audit-log policy is approved.
Mission topics, seeds, caps, success criteria, vetoes, and human roles are predeclared before results.
required_artifacts: Operator-facing review UI or documented CLI/form workflow with immutable attestation receipts.
Human claim, source-safety, omission, and workflow-blocker decision sets.
At least one full real idea/topic mission plus predeclared identifier, title, sparse-source, provider-partial, and blocked-evidence cases.
Per-mission manifests, result notes, uncertainty/nonclaim tables, and independent audits.
required_checks: Fixture/model decisions cannot impersonate human attestation.
A predeclared real idea/topic start traverses the production bootstrap route and is not substituted by a title seed.
Every required queue item has exactly one current decision and reviewer identity.
At least one real mission reaches terminal_ready_for_reviewed_prose_within_recorded_scope without bypassing a veto.
Other missions record honest terminal or boundary stops; provider failure alone does not invalidate the harness.
A second operator can follow the handoff without reconstructing hidden state.

evidence_contract.question: Can real evidence plus genuine human decisions drive the workflow to an auditable reviewed packet or honest stop?
evidence_contract.baseline: M16 fixture-labelled decisions and M21 real source/anchor evidence.
evidence_contract.primary_criterion: The predeclared mission matrix preserves exact lineage and review authority, with at least one successful within-scope idea/topic-start reviewed packet and no false readiness.
veto_diagnostics: Model or fixture output is labelled human.
A technical claim lacks a checked primary anchor or project derivation.
A source-safety, omission, or workflow blocker is bypassed.
Results are used to change success criteria after observation.

handoff_conditions: M23 receives a clean-install real-mission packet, operator evidence, known limitations, and failure-recovery record.
Any unresolved serious blocker remains a documented product limitation.
stop_conditions: No genuine human reviewer is available for the declared decisions.
Required evidence cannot be inspected or cited at the needed granularity.
The mission matrix cannot distinguish harness invalidity from a candidate mission failure.

milestones.name: North-Star Acceptance And Operational Closeout
milestones.objective: Make the clean-install one-command workflow usable by another operator, verify bounded recovery and documentation, reconcile all control artifacts, and close the north-star mission only within its explicit exploratory scope.
entry_conditions: M22 has at least one successful human-reviewed real mission and a representative set of honest boundary outcomes.
All known high-severity correctness and boundary defects are resolved or explicitly declared as release blockers.
required_artifacts: Updated README, installation, quickstart, operator-review, troubleshooting, privacy, and recovery documentation.
Independent documentation-only clean-install acceptance from an idea/topic start to terminal_ready_for_reviewed_prose_within_recorded_scope, plus separate acceptance cases for honest boundary stops.
Release manifest, compatibility matrix, known-limitations register, and final mission close record.
Reconciled mission control, milestone JSON, reset memo, and product capability statement.
required_checks: A new operator can install and discover the command from documentation alone.
The new operator takes an idea/topic start through production bootstrap and reaches the reviewed terminal without hidden manual reconstruction.
The workflow asks one bounded discovery confirmation and does not hide later genuine human review boundaries.
Resume, interruption, provider-partial, source-gap, review correction, and stale-artifact recovery are demonstrated.
The final capability statement matches code and evidence exactly.

evidence_contract.question: Has the north-star exploratory workflow become reproducible, usable, and honestly bounded for another operator?
evidence_contract.baseline: M22 engineering and real-mission evidence without final operator/release closeout.
evidence_contract.primary_criterion: Independent documentation-only clean-install acceptance takes an idea/topic start to terminal_ready_for_reviewed_prose_within_recorded_scope; separate cases reach their exact expected boundaries; all control artifacts agree.
veto_diagnostics: Hidden manual state or undocumented command is required.
A known serious correctness or boundary defect is omitted.
Documentation claims completeness, scientific correctness, autonomous review, or production scale without evidence.
Mission-control and machine-readable milestones disagree.
not_concluded: scientific correctness for all claims or domains
permission for credentials, private, paid, or unbounded sources

handoff_conditions: The north-star mission may be marked accomplished only when this milestone passes and the final close record names its exact scope and nonclaims.
stop_conditions: Independent acceptance cannot reproduce the documented workflow.
A high-severity evidence, privacy, review-authenticity, or boundary defect remains.
The requested capability would require expanding the north-star scope without a new mission decision.
